We use cookies to run RailroadRadar and (if you allow) analytics.

Cookie preferences

Choose what this site may use on your device. Essential cookies are required.

  • Essential — Account sign-in Firebase Auth keeps you signed in for reports and account features.
  • Analytics — Microsoft Clarity Helps us see how the map is used (Clarity cookies from clarity.ms).
  • Preferences — Saved settings Remembers notification and display choices in this browser (localStorage).
  • Functional — Live map tiles Loads map imagery from Mapbox / OpenStreetMap / similar providers. Needed for the map.
